steps.message:
FILES: rich/cells.py:10
ROOT CAUSE: The regex `_is_single_cell_widths` uses the range `\u0020-\u006f`, which excludes characters from 'p' (`\u0070`) to '~' (`\u007e`), causing many common ASCII strings to miss the fast path in `set_cell_size`.
CHANGE: Update the regex range from `\u0020-\u006f` to `\u0020-\u007e`.
TEST: tests/test_cells.py
